HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/steps/4: Pot life approx. 60 minutes; approx. 1.8 kg/m² per mm.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/note: Do not add water or new mortar to mortar that has already set (risk of inadequate strength development).
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS16.t|/steps/0: 5–5.25 l of water per 25 kg into a clean mixing bucket, the powder in.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS16.t|/steps/4: Pot life approx. 60 minutes; approx. 1.6 kg/m² per mm.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS16.t|/note: Up to 6 mm per application step; on BIS-5/40 after 24 hours at the earliest.
HSIMS.cr.t|/gate/title: Repair the corroding beam with your own hands
HSIMS.cr.t|/gate/desc: The spalled reinforced concrete beam of the 3D sample: saw the edges, jet out the carbonated concrete, de-rust the bar to SA 2½, protect it twice with ASOCRET-HS-FLEX, brush in the bond coat and re-profile with ASOCRET-BIS-5/40 wet in wet, smooth with ASOCRET-BIS-1/6 and cure. You guide every tool and mix every mortar with its water, mixing and activation time — and keep the pot life.
HSIMS.cr.t|/gate/foot: Seventeen phases from the technical data sheets of ASOCRET-HS-FLEX, ASOCRET-BIS-5/40 and ASOCRET-BIS-1/6; the site clock runs through the waiting times.
HSIMS.cr.t|/eyebrow: Operation briefing · Reinforced concrete beam, garage
HSIMS.cr.t|/sub: The carbonated cover has spalled off over a corroding bar. Expose and de-rust the reinforcement, protect it, bond the repair mortar wet in wet and re-profile the beam flush, then close the surface with the fine smoothing mortar — the system of ASOCRET-HS-FLEX, ASOCRET-BIS-5/40 and ASOCRET-BIS-1/6.
HSIMS.cr.t|/brief/0: Saw the edges square; break out and jet the carbonated concrete behind the bar
HSIMS.cr.t|/brief/2: ASOCRET-HS-FLEX on the steel: two coats, the second after approx. 2 hours
HSIMS.cr.t|/brief/3: Pre-wet; bond coat of ASOCRET-HS-FLEX brushed in pore-deep
HSIMS.cr.t|/brief/4: ASOCRET-BIS-5/40 wet in wet, ≤ 20 mm per step, compacted and levelled flush
HSIMS.cr.t|/brief/5: ASOCRET-BIS-1/6 after 24 hours, 1–6 mm; keep damp 3–5 days
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/0/p: Select the disc cutter and stay with it: the edges of the repair area are cut square — no feather edges.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/1/p: Select the jet lance and hold the pointer on the nozzle: the carbonated, loose concrete is removed to sound concrete, behind the bar as well — at least 20 mm clear round the steel.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/1/done: Broken out to sound concrete, the bar exposed all round.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/2/p: Select the blaster and follow it along the bar: the reinforcement is de-rusted to SA 2½, bright metal.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/3/p: Select the hose: dust and grit are rinsed off the repair area.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/4/p: Mix ASOCRET-HS-FLEX for the corrosion protection (5.5–5.75 l per 25 kg). Guide the brush: the first coat on the reinforcing steel, fully covering, approx. 1 mm.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/4/done: First coat of corrosion protection applied.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/5/p: The second coat is applied after approx. 2 hours, when the first coat is brushable. The batch goes off meanwhile.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/6/p: Mix a fresh batch and brush the second coat over the first, fully covering.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/7/p: The repair mortar can be applied approx. 6 hours after the second coat has hardened.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/8/p: Select the hose: the mineral substrate is pre-moistened so that it is matt damp at the time of application — no shiny film of water, no puddles.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/9/p: Mix ASOCRET-HS-FLEX in the bond-coat consistency (6.75–7.0 l per 25 kg). Guide the hard brush: the bond coat is brushed into the prepared substrate in a single coat, down to the pores, fully covering.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/9/done: Bond coat brushed in pore-deep — the mortar follows while it is wet.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/10/p: Mix ASOCRET-BIS-5/40. Stay with the tool: the mortar is applied into the fresh bond coat — sprayed or thrown on with the trowel — and compacted; max. 20 mm in one step.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/10/done: First layer applied wet in wet and compacted.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/11/p: Guide trowel and straight edge: the second layer is applied fresh in fresh within the pot life, compacted and levelled flush with the surface.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/12/p: ASOCRET-BIS-1/6 on BIS-5/40: after 24 hours at the earliest. Keep the mortar damp meanwhile.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/13/p: Mix ASOCRET-BIS-1/6. Guide the trowel: a scratch coat first, then the layer of 1–6 mm over the repaired area, struck off within the pot life.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/14/p: Select the sponge board and stay with it: after a corresponding waiting time the surface is treated with the felt board.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/15/p: Select the hose: the mortar is kept damp and protected from draught and sun — curing film or wet jute.
HSIMS.cr.t|/phases/16/p: Keep the mortar damp for at least 3–5 days. The site clock runs.
HSIMS.cr.t|/res_title: The beam is repaired. Steel protected, section restored, surface closed.
HSIMS.cr.t|/res_sub: Clean the tools with water immediately after use. Observe the technical data sheets and the safety data sheets; the repair principles of EN 1504-9 apply.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360P.t|/steps/0: Stir component A, add component B: 100 : 20 parts by weight.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360P.t|/steps/2: Stir in the water for the primer: 8–10 %, not more than 10 %.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360P.t|/sliderBad: The primer is diluted with 8–10 % water (max. 10 %).
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360P.t|/note: Dry substrate ≤ 5 CM-%; substrate and air 10–35 °C, 3 °C above the dew point; approx. 0.15 kg/m².
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360L.t|/steps/0: Mix component A with component B, 100 : 20 parts by weight.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360L.t|/steps/2: Thicken with the fibre filler ASO-FF for the pinholes: approx. 3 %. (Unevenness up to 2 mm: 1 : 0.5 quartz sand 0.1–0.35 mm.)
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360L.t|/sliderBad: Approx. 3 % ASO-FF thickens the resin for pinholes and recesses.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360L.t|/note: Approx. 1.6 kg/m² per mm of levelling; sanded with 100 grit and vacuumed after hardening.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360S.t|/steps/0: Mix component A with component B, 100 : 20 parts by weight.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360S.t|/steps/2: Water for the seal? The seal is applied undiluted.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360S.t|/sliderBad: The seal is mixed like the primer but applied undiluted — 0 % water.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360S.t|/note: Rolled criss-cross with the nylon fur roller, approx. 0.30–0.35 kg/m² per step.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360A.t|/steps/0: Mix component A with component B, 100 : 20 parts by weight.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360A.t|/steps/2: Stir the glass granulate ASO-Antislide into the premixed seal: 8–10 % by weight (max. 170 g/m²), stirred up during the work.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360A.t|/sliderBad: ASO-Antislide at 8–10 % by weight gives slip class R10 with V360W; the granulate goes into the last step only.
HSIMS.pf.mats.V360A.t|/note: Grain 90–150 µm; the granulate must not settle in the bucket.
HSIMS.pf.t|/gate/title: Do the garage floor over a weekend with your own hands
HSIMS.pf.t|/gate/desc: The garage of the 3D sample: shot-blast and grind the slab, read the CM test, prime with ASODUR-V360W diluted 8–10 %, fill the pinholes with ASO-FF, roll the seal criss-cross in two steps and stir ASO-Antislide into the last — each batch mixed 100 : 20 with its 40-minute pot life, each overcoat window of 16–48 hours on the site clock. You lead the crew and decide every dilution.
HSIMS.pf.t|/gate/foot: Twelve phases from the technical data sheets of ASODUR-V360W, ASO-FF, ASO-Antislide and INDUFLEX-PU.
HSIMS.pf.t|/eyebrow: Operation briefing · Garage and cellar floor
HSIMS.pf.t|/title: The aqueous seal ASODUR-V360W in two days
HSIMS.pf.t|/sub: The garage floor dusts under the tyres, drinks the oil drip and is never clean. The slab is dry and sound; the floor must be done over a weekend. The water-emulsified epoxy ASODUR-V360W is primer, levelling compound and seal in one product: diluted as the primer, filled for the pinholes, rolled criss-cross in two steps — satin, pigmented, vapour permeable, walkable after 16 hours.
HSIMS.pf.t|/brief/0: Shot blasting and edge grinding; CM test ≤ 5 CM-%, dew point
HSIMS.pf.t|/brief/2: Primer: V360W 100 : 20, diluted 8–10 %, rolled criss-cross, approx. 0.15 kg/m²
HSIMS.pf.t|/brief/3: Levelling: pinholes with approx. 3 % ASO-FF; sanded and vacuumed after hardening
HSIMS.pf.t|/brief/4: Seal: undiluted, criss-cross, 0.30–0.35 kg/m² per step; ASO-Antislide 8–10 % in the last step
HSIMS.pf.t|/brief/5: Joints with INDUFLEX-PU; driven on after 7 days
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/0/p: Select the shot blaster and stay with the crew: the slab is shot-blasted lane by lane after DIN EN 14879-1, the edges ground with the H-class vacuum on the grinder.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/1/q: The CM device reads 3.2 CM-% on the slab; the substrate is 2 °C above the dew point at 65 % relative humidity. What now?
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/1/opts/0: Wait for the climate — V360W allows ≤ 5 CM-%, but the substrate must be ≥ 3 °C above the dew point
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/1/opts/1: Start priming at once: 3.2 CM-% is dry enough
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/1/opts/2: Switch to the barrier primer ASODUR-SG3: the slab is too damp
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/1/why: V360W takes ≤ 5 CM-%; but substrate and air must be 10–35 °C and at least 3 °C above the dew point, humidity max. 65 %. Heat or ventilate first.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/2/p: Guide the crew: breakouts filled, the crack closed with the cartridge gun, the floor vacuumed dust-free.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/3/p: Mix ASODUR-V360W 100 : 20 and dilute it for the primer. Stay with the roller: the primer is rolled criss-cross with the nylon fur roller onto the dry substrate, approx. 0.15 kg/m², within the pot life of 40 minutes.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/3/done: Primed; the seal follows after min. 16 hours and within 48 hours.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/4/p: The primer hardens: overcoat after min. 16 hours, within 48 hours (beyond it the surface is sanded again).
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/5/p: Mix V360W and thicken it with ASO-FF. Guide the crew: pinholes and small recesses filled, unevenness levelled, sanded with 100 grit and vacuumed after hardening.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/5/done: Pinholes filled, surface sanded and vacuumed.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/6/p: The levelling hardens; the seal follows within the overcoat window of 16–48 hours.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/7/p: Mix V360W undiluted. Stay with the roller: the seal is rolled criss-cross, approx. 0.30–0.35 kg/m² — pigmented, satin, vapour permeable.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/7/done: First step of the seal rolled; walkable after approx. 16 hours.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/8/p: The second step after min. 16 hours and within 48 hours.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/9/p: Mix V360W and stir ASO-Antislide into it, 8–10 % by weight. Guide the crew: the last step rolled criss-cross (R10), the glass granulate stirred up during the work; then the field and wall joints filled with INDUFLEX-PU.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/10/p: Walkable after approx. 16 hours, full resilience after approx. 7 days; the garage is driven on after 7 days — tyres not turned on the spot in the first weeks.
HSIMS.pf.t|/phases/11/p: The car drives in: oil, tyre softeners, petrol and dilute acids no longer mark the floor.
HSIMS.pf.t|/res_title: The garage floor is sealed. Satin, R10, easy to clean.
HSIMS.pf.t|/res_sub: Clean the tools with water at once. Observe the technical data sheets of ASODUR-V360W, ASO-FF, ASO-Antislide and INDUFLEX-PU and the safety data sheets.
HSIMS.ca.mats.MIXP.t|/steps/0: Dose the liquid admixture with the mixing water via the dosing system of the plant and mix for more than 45 seconds; the quantity is deducted from the mixing water.
HSIMS.ca.mats.MIXP.t|/steps/1: The concrete is ready for the truck.
HSIMS.ca.mats.MIXP.t|/note: Where the truck is dosed on site: BETOCRETE-CP360-WP as 3 kg water-soluble bags, approx. 1 minute of mixing per m³ of drum content, at least 5 minutes.
HSIMS.ca.t|/gate/title: Cast the watertight basement and dose it yourself
HSIMS.ca.t|/gate/desc: The basement of the 3D sample: the crystalline waterstop in the kicker, the admixture dosed at the plant — you decide the dosing level from the w/c ratio and the cement content of the recipe, as the data sheet asks — the concrete placed and compacted, cured, backfilled, and the crack that heals when the water arrives. The decisions of the data sheet, taken by you, without a single cubic metre wasted.
HSIMS.ca.t|/gate/foot: Nine phases from the technical data sheets of BETOCRETE-CL170-P, BETOCRETE-CP360-WP and the AQUAFIN-CJ joint accessories.
HSIMS.ca.t|/eyebrow: Operation briefing · Base slab and walls below ground
HSIMS.ca.t|/sub: A basement stands in the ground: soil moisture and ground water press against the slab and the walls, the construction joint at the kicker is the weak point, and the cracks that every slab and wall develop would carry the water inside. Recipe: CEM II, 320 kg/m³ cement, w/c 0.50, dosed with BETOCRETE-CL170-P at the plant.
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/0: The crystalline waterstop AQUAFIN-CJ5 in the kicker, AQUAFIN-CJ6 on working joints, AQUAFIN-CJ1 as reserve
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/1: Dosing level from the w/c ratio: 1.75 / 1.85 / 2.00 % of the cement weight, never above 2.25 %
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/2: Mixed in the plant for more than 45 seconds
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/3: Placed in layers, fully compacted, no water added on site
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/4: Cured to the standards; crystals on the surface are not a defect
HSIMS.ca.t|/brief/5: Cracks up to 0.4 mm heal when the water arrives
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/0/p: Select the joint accessories and hold the pointer on the kicker: the crystalline waterstop AQUAFIN-CJ5 is fixed to the reinforcement before the wall is poured, the swelling tape AQUAFIN-CJ6 on the working joints, the injection hose AQUAFIN-CJ1 as reserve.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/0/done: Joints detailed with the system accessories.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/1/q: The recipe: 320 kg/m³ CEM II, w/c 0.50. The dosing level of BETOCRETE-CL170-P according to the data sheet?
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/1/why: Liquid BETOCRETE: 1.75 % below w/c 0.4, 1.85 % at w/c > 0.4–0.5, 2.00 % at w/c > 0.5–0.55 — never above 2.25 %. Preliminary tests always.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/2/q: Set the quantity of BETOCRETE-CL170-P per m³ of concrete for 320 kg/m³ of cement at 1.85 %.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/2/why: 320 kg × 1.85 % = 5.92 kg per m³; the quantity is deducted from the mixing water.
